# AI Sales Advisory

AI Sales Advisory develops voice AI solutions for travel sales and customer care, and service business reception. Guided demonstrations are available by booking a call. The travel demo uses fictional inventory; live supplier integrations require agreement. Solutions can be tailored to customer workflows and integrations, including capabilities under development or scoped for each engagement. The service receptionist demo gathers appointment details, requests confirmation, creates a calendar event and records the booking.

A shared workbench for monitoring conversations, reviewing outcomes and bringing performance metrics to executive review is currently in build.

- [Solutions](https://aisalesadvisory.com/solutions.html)
- [Book a guided demo](https://aisalesadvisory.com/contact.html)
